{{Top|leg}}
A '''Frimm bi-tail''' was a creature that was native to a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that [[Mar Balayan]] discovered. A Frimm bi-tail injured Balayan's left [[Limb/Legends|leg]], leaving the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] with a limp.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
